description: This file defines utility functions for the Git::SVN Perl module, including path and URL canonicalization, compression check, and path joining, with external dependencies on SVN::Core and Compress::Zlib.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Displays a message and exits with a fatal error code.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if Compress::Zlib is available for compression.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a file path into a canonical form safe for SVN API.

methods.name: _collapse_dotdot
methods.description: Helper function to simplify paths by resolving '..' segments.

methods.name: _canonicalize_path_ourselves
methods.description: Performs manual path canonicalization if SVN API is unavailable.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into a canonical form safe for SVN API.

methods.name: _canonicalize_url_ourselves
methods.description: Performs manual URL canonicalization if SVN API is unavailable.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments into a single path.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a path segment to a URL.
